```zig title="Zig"

    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert_with_accessible_names("<p><svg aria-label=\"Name\"><text>Drawn</text></svg></p>", false, "{\"inline_data_media\":\"AltTextOnly\",\"output_format\":\"Plain\",\"tier_strategy\":\"Tier2\"}");
```
